name: Path Lens templates — demo
description: Demonstration pack showing each Path Lens shape — identity, glob, filters, and convention-tolerant variants for emoji-prefixed and Johnny-Decimal-prefixed folder names. Use as a copy-paste reference when authoring template-shaped rules.
author: Cybersader

establish.summary: Three folders demonstrating identity (Projects), filter chain (Areas with kebab-case), and marker-only-via-glob (Capture/Inbox).

rules.name: Areas: kebab-case filter on tag side
rules.description: Areas/{area} ↔ #areas/{area | kebab-case} — conditional bijection (round-trips for clean inputs)

rules.name: Projects: glob slot for arbitrary depth
Inbox: marker-only via discarded glob
rules.description: Capture/Inbox/{discarded...} ↔ #-inbox — provably lossy (folder-only slot). Recoverable per-file via F3 frontmatter witness.

rules.name: Emoji-prefixed PARA: 📁 Projects
rules.description: 📁 Projects/{topic} ↔ #projects/{topic} — total bijection, literal emoji prefix in the template means the rule fires only on emoji-prefixed folders. Author the template to match your folder convention; no normalization magic needed.

rules.name: Johnny Decimal + emoji: 📁 01 - Projects
rules.description: 📁 01 - Projects/{topic} ↔ #projects/{topic} — emoji + JD prefix in the literal; slot only captures the topic. The JD number itself is part of the literal match (not captured as a slot), so it must be authored verbatim. For users with stable JD numbering this is the simplest move.

notes: This pack ships 6 template rules — only the first 2 are enabled by default. Enable rules 3-6 manually to experiment.
Rule 1 (identity): green chip — round-trips perfectly. Use as a starting template.
Rule 2 (kebab-case filter): yellow chip — conditional. Round-trips for inputs that are already lowercase-with-hyphens.
Rule 3 (glob slot): green chip — round-trips when both sides use glob.
Rule 4 (marker-only): orange chip — lossy by design. Multiple inbox files collapse to one tag. Per-file recovery requires F3 (frontmatter witness, future).
Rule 5 (emoji-prefixed PARA): green chip. Matches '📁 Projects/Web Auth' style folders directly via literal emoji in the template. Copy + adjust the emoji + folder name for your own convention.
Rule 6 (JD + emoji): green chip. Matches '📁 01 - Projects/Web Auth'. The JD number is part of the literal — for stable numbering only. Dynamic JD numbers would need a future {jd-number}-style slot.
